definitions.explanation: A small firearm designed to be held and fired with one hand.

examples.japanese: {拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧だ。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The suspect was carrying a handgun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧{拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押収|おうしゅう}→押収：19033_oushuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police seized the illegally possessed handgun.

notes:
{拳銃|けんじゅう} is composed of {拳|けん} (fist) + ⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧ (gun) — literally a gun that fits in the fist.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to possess a handgun
- {拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発砲|はっぽう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fire a handgun
- {拳銃|けんじゅう}⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧: illegal possession of a firearm
- けん{銃|じゅう}⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧: armed robbery

CULTURAL NOTE: Japan has extremely strict gun control laws ({銃刀法|じゅうとうほう}). Private ownership of firearms is nearly completely prohibited. The word appears frequently in crime news and detective fiction but rarely in everyday conversation.
